label: database
definition: An information content entity that is accessed through the use of a database management system.
axiom: 'is specified input of' some ('data transformation' and ('has participant' some 'database management system'))

label: database management system
definition: A piece of software that provides utilities for database administration, through which end users and applications access the database.

label: relational database
definition: A database that presents data to the user in tabular form and provides relational operators to manipulate that tabular data.

label: relation
definition: An information content entity that is part of a relational database and that consists of a heading defining a set of attributes and a body made up of data in tuples corresponding to those attributes.

label: relation header
definition: An information content entity that is part of a relation and that contains the names and data types of each attribute in the relation.

label: relation body
definition: An information content entity that is part of a relation and that consists of all tuples in that relation.

label: tuple
definition: An information content entity that is part of a relation and that consists of zero or more values that are each part of one attribute in the relation.

label: attribute
definition: An information content entity that is part of a relation and that consists of at most one value from each tuple in the relation.

label: value
definition: An information content entity that is part of a tuple and an attribute.

label: database component
definition: An information content entity that is part of a database.

label: querying process
definition: A data transformation that produces a relation from an input database based on the specification of an input query.
axiom: 'has specified input' some 'database'|'has specified input' some 'query'|'has specified output' some 'relation'

label: query
definition: A directive information entity that determines the contents of the relation output by a querying process.
